steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before servicing electrical parts. For voltage checks on powered circuits, use appropriate PPE and one-hand test technique.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug the appliance before the changing or repairing the electric parts.

steps.title: Apply power for voltage test
steps.body: Restore power. Allow control to stabilize. Measure sensor voltage at MAIN PCB with harness connected.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Restore power. Allow control to stabilize. Measure sensor voltage at MAIN PCB with harness connected.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Service mode or self-diagnostic entered. Continue with component-specific checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After test mode entry, proceed with OEM component tests.

steps.title: Sensor voltage
steps.body: Measure voltage CN40 18 ↔ 20 — 4.5 V warm → 1.0 V cold per OEM table.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure voltage CN40 18 ↔ 20 — 4.5 V warm → 1.0 V cold per OEM table.
